title: Chapter 364 Founding The Human Emperor Palace
content:
Chapter 364 Founding The Human Emperor Palace

"This is?"

The fear in everyone's eyes gradually turned into doubt, because they saw that the women in front of them were all human race, just like them.

Could it be that this person who happened to be wandering near the Chaos Realm and felt the Blood Summoning coming to support him?

Everyone in the human race thought so.

An Changzai and the other two were also looking at the woman in front of them.

Unexpectedly, they couldn't see through the woman.

No surprise, either because this woman is extremely strong, just like Lu Daosheng, or there is someone behind this woman.

At this time, the woman looked straight at Lu Daosheng in the crowd and smiled.

"Dad, long time no see."

father!

Everyone was shocked and hurriedly looked at Lu Daosheng beside him.

Lu Daosheng also had a smile on his face. Looking at Lu Xue in the distance, his eyes were a little wet.

"Xiaoxue, you have grown up."

Hearing this, Lu Xue responded with a smile, "Yes, after all, my father is not around, and it's not okay not to grow up."

There was a little resentment in the words.

Lu Daosheng naturally heard it. Apart from a embarrassed smile, he didn't say anything.

At this time, Lu Xue quickly saw the situation present.

She is no longer the little girl who only knew how to call her father back then.

Buzz —

In an instant, a sound of swords that resounded through the world suddenly rang out.

Immediately afterwards, a golden long sword appeared in Lu Xue's hand. She pointed to the sky from afar and chanted loudly: "From this moment, the human race in the Chaos Realm will be protected by the Human Emperor Palace!"

boom!

The human race only felt a vigorous force exploded in the bloodline in its body.

Several elderly human seniors looked at Lu Xue, or to be precise, they were looking at the Xuanyuan Sword in Lu Xue's hand.

On the one hand, the sun, moon, mountains and rivers are engraved, and on the other hand, the mountains, rivers, plants and trees are engraved. This represents the fortune of the human race. It will not be wrong, it will not be wrong!

This is exactly the legendary Human Emperor’s sword and Xuanyuan sword!

One of the legendary treasures of the human race is said to contain the luck of the entire human race.

Human Emperor, Human Emperor!

When they looked at Lu Xuezhi again, the old men were already filled with tears.

"We wait, welcome the successor of the Human Emperor!"

The successor of the Human Emperor.

The human race has been shocked many times at this time.

When they heard the four words "Successor of the Human Emperor", they did not hesitate and knelt down and saluted.

An Chang was there, Wu Shang and Huo Xingzhi looked at each other and saw the shock in each other's eyes.

What kind of person are they? How could they not know the Xuanyuan Sword? The successor of the Human Emperor is not fake.

Immediately, the three of them also knelt on one knee to show respect.

This is the value of the successor of the Human Emperor.

At the same time, an indescribable aura seemed to appear out of thin air and slowly penetrated into everyone's bodies.

Everyone only felt that their thoughts were clear and their spirits were refreshed.

This is the power of luck.

Once a race loses its luck, it will be not far from destruction.

At this moment, Lu Xue stood proudly in the void like a savior, holding a sword in one hand, and was full of energy.

In this way, after endless years, the Human Emperor Palace was established from the Chaos Realm.

Lu Xue is the first master of the Human Emperor Hall in Chaos Realm.

It can also fulfill Lu Xue’s promise to Qin Yi in the Wanling Realm - to strengthen the Human Emperor Palace.

......

Half a day later.

The human race began to send strong men to regain their lost territory one after another, but it was only part of it.

In this battle, their human race still hurt their vitality and the strong lost a lot.

But now, with the successor of the Human Emperor, three top strong men, and an unfathomable boss, it is only a matter of time before their human race recovers or even returns to the top.

In a quiet courtyard.

Lu Daosheng lay comfortably on the rocking chair, enjoying the sun's bathing comfortably.

And at this time, with a squeak, a young woman came over slowly.

"father."

Lu Xue looked at Lu Daosheng at this time, with a little helplessness in her eyes.

My father is good at everything, but sometimes he is too lazy.

Although she used to be like this, she has changed it now, but Lu Daosheng can't change it because no one can care about him.

"Oh, Xiaoxue, how are you doing now."

Lu Daosheng raised his eyes and said.

Lu Xue took a deep breath and her voice became a little cold.

"Those miscellaneous things have not been as you say until now, and there is not a single one."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng stopped the shaking chair under him and then slowly stood up.

It can be seen from the naked eye that Lu Daosheng's face was a little cold.

"Haha, it seems that I really don't take my words."

"Since that's the case, then I'll,

Before he finished speaking, Lu Daosheng was suddenly stunned and then looked up at the sky.

"Dad, what's wrong?"

Seeing Lu Daosheng's unusual behavior, Lu Xue looked a little confused.

But when she looked into the sky, she saw nothing but a calmness.

Lu Daosheng did not respond.

Of course Lu Xue couldn't see it. After all, her strength is still very low in the Chaos Realm.

Of course, it's useless even if you catch up.

In the entire Chaos Realm, only Lu Daosheng has this strength.

"Xiaoxue, keep staring at them. Dad goes out to do something and go back."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, and after leaving this sentence, he disappeared directly in the yard.

Standing there, Lu Xue curled her lips and sighed.

When I gently pushed open the door, I saw An Chang standing quietly outside the door waiting.

"District Master, what did your father say?"

Hearing An Changzai’s question, Lu Xue was silent for a moment and said, “There should be an answer soon.”

An Changzai frowned slightly, but didn't ask any more questions.

She is now working for Lu Xue.

Lu Xue did not treat An Changzai and the other two at all. She now needs several capable and powerful helpers.

So she hired An Changzai and gave the three of them a generous reward.

How rich is it? Even the three of them cannot refuse it.

This is the power of wealth.

At the same time, outside the Chaos Realm.

A figure suddenly walked slowly from the chaotic void.

His body was covered with scars, but he was indifferent.

Soon, he came to the outside world barrier.

Looking at the outer barriers in front of him, he had a little emotion in his eyes.

"I haven't been back for a long time."

Immediately, a blood arrow slowly condensed from his hand and then shot forward.

Buzz —

Space flow.

The blood arrow disappeared out of thin air.

"Who?"

He looked puzzled and looked in front of him with a serious look.

The next moment, the space trembled and Lu Daosheng's figure slowly emerged.

"Maybe, coming back is not a good thing."

Lu Daosheng spoke softly, looking at the creatures in the distance with pity in his eyes.

"Who are you?"

There was a hint of fear in the creature's eyes, and his bloodline gradually boiled.

He is a powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan.

Faced with the questioning of this god-blood creature, Lu Daosheng had no expression on his face, "The one who killed you."

laugh!

A blood light flashed by.

The head of the Divine Blood Clan creature flew up instantly.

Meanwhile, all his blood withered in an instant.

At the last moment before his consciousness dissipated, a name that he had been fond of for a long time appeared in his mind.

Blood Dao Killing Technique - Blood Disaster in the Yellow Spring.
